_about: What is RECORDED about the 10 modules MES lists for the 2018 Stelvio (VIN ZASFAKPN5J7B88115) that CUORE has never read. Facts only: unknown stays unknown, nothing here is an address, bitrate or request to try. 'address.confirmed' is true only when a CUORE reply with this car's VIN came from that address. mes_evidence lists MES log files on disk (read-only) with the date in the file; 'this_car' is false when the log's own VIN line does not read this car's VIN. For the Modules page owner to read; no page shows this file yet.

sources.registry: cuore/live/addressing.py (bus and address rows, with their own notes)
sources.mes_logs: C:\Program Files (x86)\MultiEcuScan: SCAN_*.txt and FESLog_*.txt, dates taken from the file header or name
sources.cuore_audit: C:\ProgramData\cuore\audit.jsonl searched 2026-10-31 for each module code as the target: no row for any of the 10

shared_note_fes_vin_line: Every non-ECU FESLog listed below prints the VIN line '5188214', which is not this car's VIN (ends 88115). Those logs are recorded as evidence that MES opens the module, not as readings of this car. The B0110-15 and P068A-68 lines appear identically in the AFLS, radio and blind-spot logs, so they are not treated as a per-module reading.
